changes: Add an injectable executor/queue port with stable enrolled device identity, fixed local recipe argv and strict job schema; job payloads cannot supply command text or executable paths.
Verify canonical enrolled repository and linked worktree, exact Git HEAD revision, recipe permissions and registered resource caps before spawning with shell:false.

Persist launch intent, attempt/job/worker/incarnation/boot identity, PID/start/PGID, owned descendant observations, worktree/profile identity, output cursor and a sealed lease receipt in an atomic private journal; add an exclusive worker lock with stale-owner identity checks.
Bound runtime and output, keep an exact 64 KiB byte tail, hash fixed recipe-allowlisted artifacts under a byte/count cap, and fence heartbeat/result/stop failures as ambiguous.

Cancel only the recorded process group and observed descendants after PID/start checks; retain the attempt until the queue accepts a cleanup receipt. On restart, reconcile server lease and process identity, resume heartbeats for a surviving same-boot process, and never replay its recipe.

Define exactly three exclusive Hermes profile/worktree registration slots and refuse launch unless pinned runtime and auth are verified; no Hermes executable, auth, provider or profile was inspected or configured.
Document supervisor, service UID, private state, backoff, bounded logs, OS resource enforcement and enrollment gates without installing a service.

Require an authenticated fresh start permit before launch intent/spawn, bound to attempt, stable worker/profile ID, target device, Hermes profile, root, worktree, recipe, exact revision and all resource caps; recheck permit expiry and canonical local execution identity immediately before spawn.

Separate stable worker/profile ID from enrolled hardware device ID throughout registry and queue lease/receipt semantics; validate worker and attempt identifiers against a path/control-safe allowlist.
Add temporary marker regressions for rejected schema-valid leases, mismatched permits, and permits expiring during prelaunch verification; all prove no executable side effect occurs.
Require a clean initial Git worktree at the exact requested HEAD; reject tracked edits and untracked files without resetting or deleting user content.
Capture bounded post-run source-change status/diff hashes as attempt result evidence so intentional agent edits remain in place and attributable.

Fence each physical worktree and Hermes home across worker processes and separate journal paths using a shared private coordination directory; hold reservations until cleanup and queue settlement are proven.
Replace stale-lock reclamation with fail-closed directory locks. Never auto-unlink stale or replaced lock identities; require explicit operator reconciliation.

Require canonical private Hermes profile homes owned by the service account, pin root/worktree/profile-home device/inode identity across awaited authorization, and recheck identities immediately before spawn.
Require exact live PID start-time and PGID identity before cancellation signals; missing process inspection is unknown and refuses numeric process-group signaling.
Probe process inspection during worker construction before journals or claims, so a runner that denies ps cannot spawn a recipe child.
Serialize reconcile and cancel journal mutations with the supervisor lock; hold the lock through a recovered watcher and release it after terminal settlement.

Recover physical worktree/profile reservations only after exact process identity and queue ownership reconcile; transfer stale owner records through a guarded atomic claim and fail closed on changed identity.
Recovered watchers stop renewal when PID/start/PGID identity is not positively observable and enforce the original persisted deadline/output state.
Add real temporary root/worktree inode replacement and unavailable-process-inspection startup regressions.
Track recovered watcher lifecycle as an owned promise and expose drainRecovery() so shutdown and fixtures can await the actual finalizer.
Catch watcher and finalizer errors, persist bounded recoveryError evidence, fence a still-running attempt as ambiguous, and keep reservation locks fail-closed when journal updates fail.
Update reattachment and remaining-wall fixtures to await recovered watcher finalization; add an owner-replacement regression for observable finalizer failure.
Correct the worker README to describe implemented local root/worktree identity, clean revision, and active reservation checks while retaining server mount/provisioning and OS containment limits.

Add a POSIX durable lease sealer using a private canonical mode-0700 state directory, exclusive atomic 256-bit key creation, no-follow bounded key reads, stable restart decryption, AES-256-GCM versioned AAD, and fail-closed tamper/key replacement handling; no production key was generated and the worker does not auto-wire it.

Route every worker process-group TERM/KILL through a fresh recorded PID/start/PGID ownership check, including startup cleanup; unknown ownership remains ambiguous with reservation held. Add an injected identity-replacement regression proving no unowned TERM/KILL is sent.

Loop over partial key writes until all 32 bytes are stored; reject zero or invalid progress, fsync and verify temporary file identity/size/contents before exclusive hard-link publication, and remove only the temporary file this initializer created.

Add injected short-write, zero-progress, changed-temporary-content, and existing-exclusive-temp regressions proving incomplete keys are never published and pre-existing temporary files/errors are preserved.
Reject oversized sealed lease strings before key IO, regex matching, or base64 decoding.

integration_limitations: No authenticated RPC adapter, scheduler loop, C02/C04 integration, queue database migration, or VPS authority is connected. QueuePort is an interface only; ROOT owns transport, auth and reservation wiring.

Wall-time/output/artifact limits are enforced in-process. Memory/CPU values are admission ceilings until launchd/systemd plus Linux cgroups or verified macOS resource controls are configured and measured.

POSIX process groups and a 100 ms ancestry scan catch tested detached descendants, but they are not OS-enforced containment and can miss a descendant that escapes and exits between scans. Do not treat the stop receipt as deployment proof until host-specific containment is independently verified. Windows is explicitly refused.

Root and worktree canonical paths and exact HEAD are checked locally; device/inode, mount identity, dirty/untracked source manifest, exclusive worktree leasing across device profiles and physical storage-pool attestation remain server enrollment/reservation responsibilities.
Artifact evidence covers only registered relative files. No remote artifact upload/store is connected. Logs remain local in the private journal and are not published by this slice.

Hermes slot contracts are declarations only. Actual Hermes binary/version, supported arguments/resume, profile homes, credentials, tool permissions, provider budget and isolation remain unverified; no model/provider calls or real project job ran.
No launchd/systemd service was installed or exercised. No AWS connection or historical external-drive queue action occurred; AWS and the historical queue remain deferred/paused.

All local workers must be configured with the same private coordinationPath on a device. Stale/unreadable reservation directories fail closed and require operator verification; no automatic stale-lock deletion or lock-transfer RPC is implemented.

The portable worker enforces wall time, output-byte and artifact-evidence caps. MemoryBytes and CPUCount are validated admission ceilings only; no cgroup, rlimit, macOS resource limit, or hard CPU/RSS enforcement is implemented.

After supervisor restart the prior stdout/stderr pipes cannot be reattached, so output already persisted is checked but additional bytes from a surviving process cannot be measured. Recipes requiring strict restart-time output enforcement remain disabled.
Recovery depends on working POSIX process inspection. If PID/start/PGID cannot be positively inspected or cleanup cannot be proven, the worker leaves journal/resource locks fenced and does not rerun.

The new durable lease sealer is a local POSIX file-key primitive and is not automatically wired into the worker or production state; no user-state key was created. Windows remains unsupported pending verified ACL enforcement.
The current six-file freeze has only local Node v26 validation; ROOT Node 24 acceptance and peer review remain pending.

api_contract_coordination.root_authority: ROOT adapter must bind authenticated C02 claims to server-owned CloudRootAuthority.getFreshRoot({projectId, deviceId}); job paths confer no authority. C05 canonical root and exact revision checks are an additional local execution gate.
api_contract_coordination.reservation: CloudWorker.reservedBytes is total heartbeat reservation including queue-owned estimates; adapter reports once without double counting. C05 does not implement the adapter.
api_contract_coordination.routing: ROOT to coordinate these meanings with C02 and route BUILD2 review, followed by ROOT review.

reported_findings_recheck.worktree_profile_collision: Shared execution reservations fence physical worktrees and profile homes across independent state paths.
reported_findings_recheck.stale_lock_unlink: Stale lock reclamation was removed; stale/replaced lock identities fail closed without unlink.
reported_findings_recheck.dirty_source_and_profile_home: Dirty/untracked initial source, symlinked homes and identity replacement are rejected; agent-created result edits are preserved and hashed.
reported_findings_recheck.lifecycle: Cancellation ownership checks, cleanup-proof reservation fencing, same-boot reattachment, reboot ambiguity and no-replay behavior retained.

start_authorization_boundary.queue_contract: QueuePort.authorizeStart must authenticate the durable lease, ownership, current device/root authority and reservation before returning a permit. This interface is not an authenticated transport implementation.
start_authorization_boundary.pre_spawn_checks: Permit expiry is checked after fresh authorization and again after durable launch-intent journaling; root/worktree canonical paths, linked-worktree status, exact HEAD, recipe executable/argv and profile home are resolved again immediately before spawn.
start_authorization_boundary.identity: Queue claims, lease receipts and stop receipts use registry.workerId. WorkerJob.deviceId remains the enrolled hardware target; a device may host distinct worker/profile identities.
